Recalling their previous diplomatic engagement in New Delhi, Prime Minister Modi highlighted their shared commitment to expanding multifaceted cooperation across bilateral and global domains. "Thank you President Lee Jae-myung for your warm message," PM Modi said in a post on X. "I fondly recall your visit to India in April, which gave fresh momentum to our Special Strategic Partnership." Reaffirming New Delhi's intention to work closely with Seoul to address regional and global challenges, the Prime Minister emphasised their common vision for long-term stability and economic advancement. "I am confident that together we will deepen our multifaceted cooperation and advance our shared vision for global peace, stability and prosperity," PM Modi added. "I am confident that together we will deepen our multifaceted cooperation and advance our shared vision for global peace, stability and prosperity," PM Modi added.
